title: A city that builds as you move
label: TURKU3D / IN DEVELOPMENT
text: This is Turku, running in a browser. Drive beyond the familiar streets, and the world builds around you.

title: One permit. A city of deliveries.
label: PLAY THE CITY
text: Get a courier permit under Aura Bridge. Walk the riverbank, drive the route, and turn pizza deliveries into money.

title: Play together
label: PLAY TOGETHER
text: Bring your friends. Drive together, vote for a timed round, and race to earn the most.

title: Basic first. Textured next.
label: ON-DEMAND WORLD
text: As players move, the generator builds new tiles. This isolated build uses the same server and cached stages. First, geometry and collision. Then, textures. The clock shows real elapsed time.

title: Start with the laser returns
label: 01 / MEASURE THE CITY
text: Lidar records measured positions. Classification separates ground from roofs, trees and other objects.

title: Height becomes terrain and collision
label: GROUND / STRUCTURES
text: Ground samples become terrain and collision. Mapped curbs and stairs add structure; their heights still need checks.

title: The same camera over the office block
label: 2022 TRUE ORTHOPHOTO → GAME
text: The twenty twenty two aerial image and game show the same office block, from the same camera.

title: Roof shapes checked against lidar
label: CITY LOD2 + BUILDING REGISTER
text: City models supply roof shapes. Available lidar checks and refines the roof envelope.

title: Map tags become a connected world
label: OPENSTREETMAP / LOCAL EXTRACT
text: OpenStreetMap supplies streets, trees, barriers and bridge tags. Roads connect; fences follow terrain; bridge decks carry the crossing.

title: Parameters become a facade
label: FACADE PARAMETERS → PROCEDURAL MAP
text: Local facade references become colour, storeys and window rhythm: parameters rendered procedurally, without photograph pixels.

title: Two passes. Reuse unchanged work.
label: TURKU CATHEDRAL / CURRENT GAME
text: Content hashes reuse stages. Basic tiles first; textured detail next.

title: A small host. A streamed world.
label: GENERATOR → BROWSER
text: Models and collision stream through a forwarder to the browser. Web G P U draws; Rapier handles physics.

title: 1,555 / 2,401 tiles warm
label: MEASURED / 30 OCTOBER 2026
text: The earlier capture counted fifteen hundred and fifty five warm tiles. A separate sixty four core run built eleven hundred and twenty eight in thirty six minutes. Coverage remains incomplete.

title: The next street is waiting.
label: TURKU3D
text: A real city, a working game, and a world that keeps growing. Turku three D.
